webster.text: Boyish; childish; trifling; as a puerile amusement.

example.quote: The gentleman had charged his argument, that it would be the interest of Congress to diminish the number of representatives, as being puerile.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 21, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
